.. change::
    :tags: performance, sql
    :tickets: 13506

    Improved the performance of SQL cache key generation by generating the
    whole traversal for a particular construct as inline code at class setup
    time, rather than generating a list of dispatch symbols that a runtime
    loop then had to interpret on every cache key generation.  As which
    handler applies to which attribute is constant for a given class, the
    chain of identity comparisons that formerly rediscovered this per
    attribute, per cache key is now resolved once, when the class' traversal
    function is first generated.  Benchmarks against a range of Core and ORM
    statements show cache key generation running approximately 1.3 to 1.8
    times faster, with the generated cache keys themselves unchanged.
